changelog: Monochrome Black & White Settings Redesign: Strict developer aesthetic (Linear/Raycast standard) with official embedded logos (Google Antigravity 4-point spark, Claude Code sunburst spark, GitHub Copilot mark) directly on dark surfaces with no background boxes, monospace badges, and unclipped responsive HUD telemetry ribbon
GitHub Copilot Full Integration in Accounts & Status Bar: Added GitHub Copilot to the drawer footer account status bar with official logo badge, and first-class Copilot section in the Accounts sheet

Space-Efficient Expandable Accounts Sheet: Added collapsible provider accordions and an Expand/Collapse All toggle in the Accounts dialog so multiple configured subscriptions don't consume excessive screen space

Ultra-Resilient Copilot Chat Completions: Fixed streaming & non-streaming response handling, multi-line JSON parsing, conversation file persistence, and tier-specific free included models (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, o3-mini)
